radical-above: A short stroke sits ABOVE the line, like a bird perched on a wire.
radical-axe-cutting-fresh-wood: The shape is an axe head on a long handle, swung down to split fresh wood.
radical-below: A stroke hangs BELOW the line, like a lantern dangling under a beam.
radical-big: A person stretching arms and legs as wide as possible: BIG.
radical-cave: A roof with two openings beneath: the dark mouth of a CAVE.
radical-change: A standing person beside a flipped person: someone CHANGING form.
radical-child: A baby wrapped in a blanket with arms flung out: a CHILD.
radical-craft: An I-beam on a building site: the tool of every CRAFT worker.
radical-ear: The outline of an EAR with folds inside and the lobe at the bottom.
radical-earth: A cross stuck into the ground line: a stake planted in the EARTH.
radical-eat: A lid over a steaming bowl of rice, ready to EAT.
radical-every: A mother figure with a hat on: EVERY mother wears one on the school run.
radical-eye: An EYE turned on its side, with the pupil lines across the middle.
radical-father-holding-a-stick: Two crossed sticks under two strokes: FATHER waving his walking stick.
radical-fire: A person with sparks flying from both arms: a crackling FIRE.
radical-foot: A mouth on top, a leg striding below: the FOOT that carries you.
radical-gold: A roof over a heap of nuggets in the earth: buried GOLD.
radical-good: A shining dot on top of a sturdy base: something GOOD stands out.
radical-growth: A sprout pushing up through layers of soil: GROWTH.
radical-hand: A palm with three fingers spread and a thumb hooked down: a HAND.
radical-hands: Two short strokes reaching out, like a pair of HANDS grabbing.
radical-i: Five people talking through one mouth: "I" am speaking for all of us.
radical-intersect: A lid on top of crossing legs: two roads that INTERSECT.
radical-legs: Two strokes walking apart: a pair of LEGS mid-stride.
radical-lightning: A box split by a stroke that shoots straight through it: LIGHTNING.
radical-middle: A line shot straight through the MIDDLE of a box.
radical-moon: A tall crescent with two lines of light inside: the MOON.
radical-mouth: An open square: a MOUTH saying "oh".
radical-nurturing-woman: A woman holding two little ones close: a NURTURING mother.
radical-person: Two legs leaning together: a PERSON walking.
radical-plant: Two little sprouts crossing a line of soil: a PLANT.
radical-rain: Drops falling from under a cloud roof: RAIN.
radical-rice: Grains scattering from a crossed stalk: RICE.
radical-rice-field: A square field cut into four paddies: a RICE FIELD.
radical-river: Three lines flowing side by side: a RIVER.
radical-root-line: A single flat stroke: the ROOT LINE everything is built on.
radical-small: A tiny stroke with two crumbs falling off it: SMALL.
radical-speech: Lines of sound coming out above a mouth: SPEECH.
radical-stand: A person with a hat, legs planted on the ground: STAND tall.
radical-steam: Wisps rising and curling over a pot: STEAM.
radical-strength: An arm flexing its biceps: STRENGTH.
radical-sun: A window with a line across: the SUN shining through it.
radical-sun-ray-white-light: The sun with a ray shooting off the top: bright WHITE light.
radical-tall-building: A roof, a window, a door, stacked high: a TALL BUILDING.
radical-three-peaks: Three peaks rising from one ridge: a mountain range.
radical-tree: A trunk with branches out and roots spreading down: a TREE.
radical-walking: A single sweeping stroke: a foot sliding forward, WALKING.
radical-water: Three drops splashing on the left side: WATER.
radical-well: Two pairs of crossed logs: the frame around a village WELL.
radical-wheel: A cart seen from above: axle through the middle, a WHEEL on each side.
radical-woman-kneeling: A figure kneeling with arms crossed gracefully: a WOMAN.
radical-yawn: A person with a wide-open mouth leaning back: a big YAWN, lacking sleep.
kanji-u4e07: まん (man): one MAN holding up ten thousand coins on a hook.
kanji-u4f11: A person (亻) leaning on a tree (木): taking a REST. やすむ: "ya, sumu" — yeah, I'll stay here and rest.
kanji-u5317: Two people sitting back to back, facing away from the sun: the cold NORTH. きた: the north wind "kita!" (it's here!).
kanji-u5348: A pestle standing straight up at its tallest: the sun at NOON. ご (go): go eat lunch at noon.
kanji-u5357: A sunny tent with ten (十) on top: warm lands to the SOUTH. みなみ: "me, nami" — I ride waves down south.
kanji-u53cb: Two hands (𠂇 and 又) clasped together: a FRIEND. とも: "tomo" — tomorrow, too, with my friend.
kanji-u540d: Evening (夕) plus a mouth (口): in the dark you call out your NAME so friends know it's you. な: "na"-me.
kanji-u5929: A big person (大) with the sky as a line above their head: the HEAVENS. てん: "ten" out of ten, heavenly.
kanji-u6771: The sun (日) rising behind a tree (木): sunrise in the EAST. ひがし: "he gasps, see!" — the sun's up in the east.
kanji-u897f: A bird settling into its nest at dusk, when the sun sets in the WEST. にし: "knee-she" — she knelt to watch the sunset.
vocab-n5-aa: "Ah!" — the sound you make when you finally get it.
vocab-n5-abiru: あびる: "a beer" after you SHOWER — bathe, then drink.
vocab-n5-abunai: あぶない: "a boon? Nay!" — that's DANGEROUS, not a boon.
vocab-n5-achira: あちら: polite "over there" — あ is the far-away family (あれ, あそこ, あちら).
vocab-n5-ageru: 上げる: 上 (up) — RAISE it up, like raising your hand to answer.
vocab-n5-akai: 赤い: "a kite" that's bright RED against the sky.
vocab-n5-akarui: 明るい: 明 = sun 日 + moon 月 — both shining at once: BRIGHT.
vocab-n5-akeru: 開ける: 開 has a gate 門 with hands lifting the bar: you OPEN it.
vocab-n5-aki: 秋: rice plant 禾 next to fire 火 — burning stubble after harvest in AUTUMN.
vocab-n5-aku: 開く: the gate 門 swings and OPENS on its own (no object).
vocab-n5-amai: 甘い: "a my!" — oh my, that's SWEET.
vocab-n5-amari: 余り: "a marry" — not very keen on marrying; there's plenty LEFT OVER.
vocab-n5-ame: 飴: "ah, may!" — ah, may I have a CANDY?
vocab-n5-anata: あなた: "Ann, a tar" — YOU, Ann, are a star. (Careful: often too direct.)
vocab-n5-ano: あの: "ah, no" — not this one, THAT one over there.
vocab-n5-aoi: 青い: "ah, oi!" — shouting at the wide BLUE sea.
vocab-n5-apaato: アパート: "apart-ment" cut short to APARTMENT.
vocab-n5-are: あれ: "are" you seeing THAT thing over there?
vocab-n5-aru: 在る: ある is for things that just sit there EXISTING (not living).
vocab-n5-aru-2: 有る: 有 = a hand holding meat 月: to HAVE something.
vocab-n5-asagohan: 朝御飯: あさ (morning) + ごはん (meal) = BREAKFAST.
vocab-n5-asatte: 明後日: "a sat-day" — the day after tomorrow could be Saturday.
vocab-n5-ashi: 足: a mouth 口 on top of a striding leg: your FOOT and LEG.
vocab-n5-asoko: あそこ: "ah, so co-" — ah, so it's over THERE.
vocab-n5-atatakai: 暖かい: "a tatty kai" — a tatty old blanket that's still WARM.
vocab-n5-atchi: あっち: casual あちら — "atchoo!" sneeze over THERE.
vocab-n5-atsui: 熱い: "ahh, tsui!" — ouch, the pot is HOT to touch.
vocab-n5-atsui-2: 厚い: a cliff 厂 over a sun-thick pile: a THICK book.
vocab-n5-au: 会う: "ow!" — bumping into a friend: to MEET.
vocab-n5-ban: 晩: the sun 日 slipping away: EVENING. "Ban" the lights on at evening.
vocab-n5-ban-2: 番: your BAN-dage number in the queue — number one, number two.
vocab-n5-bangou: 番号: "bang-go!" — shout your NUMBER and go.
vocab-n5-bataa: バター: BUTTER, just said the Japanese way.
vocab-n5-benri: 便利: "Ben, really!" — Ben's gadget is so CONVENIENT.
vocab-n5-boorupen: ボールペン: "ball pen" — a BALLPOINT PEN.
vocab-n5-bunshou: 文章: "bun show" — a show of words: a piece of TEXT.
vocab-n5-butaniku: 豚肉: ぶた (pig) + にく (meat) = PORK.
vocab-n5-chawan: 茶碗: ちゃ (tea) + わん (bowl) — a tea bowl, now a RICE BOWL.
vocab-n5-chigau: 違う: "cheek, go!" — wrong cheek! It's DIFFERENT.
vocab-n5-chiisana: 小さな: ちいさい's cousin — "cheesy" little thing: SMALL.
vocab-n5-chikai: 近い: "cheek eye" — so NEAR your cheek touches my eye.
vocab-n5-chikaku: 近く: the NEARBY area — "chick a coo" from the nearby coop.
vocab-n5-chizu: 地図: "cheese" — a MAP with holes like Swiss cheese.
vocab-n5-chotto: ちょっと: "show toe" — just show A LITTLE bit of toe.
vocab-n5-choudo: 丁度: "Cho! dough!" — EXACTLY enough dough.
vocab-n5-chuu: ～中: 中 = a line through the middle — in the MIDDLE of doing something.
vocab-n5-dai: ～台: "dai" — the counter for machines and cars, each on its own platform.
vocab-n5-daidokoro: 台所: "die, dough, coro" — where the dough is made: the KITCHEN.
vocab-n5-daigaku: 大学: 大 (big) + 学 (study) = big study: UNIVERSITY.
vocab-n5-daijoubu: 大丈夫: "dye, joe, boo" — Joe dyed his hair blue? IT'S OK!
vocab-n5-dake: ～だけ: "darkie" — ONLY one light left on.
vocab-n5-dandan: 段々: 段 is a step — step by step: GRADUALLY.
vocab-n5-dare: 誰: "dare" you tell me WHO did it?
vocab-n5-dareka: 誰か: who + か (question) = SOMEONE, I don't know who.
vocab-n5-dasu: 出す: 出 (exit) — make something come out: TAKE OUT, hand in.
vocab-n5-deha: では: "day-wa" — WELL THEN, let's call it a day.
vocab-n5-dekakeru: 出かける: 出 (exit) — head out the door: GO OUT.
vocab-n5-dekiru: できる: "decks clear" — the decks are clear, now I CAN do it.
vocab-n5-demo: でも: "demo" — the demo looked good, BUT it crashed.
vocab-n5-denki: 電気: 電 (lightning) + 気 (energy) = ELECTRICITY, LIGHT.
vocab-n5-depaato: デパート: "depart-ment" store, shortened: DEPARTMENT STORE.
vocab-n5-do: ～度: "dough" — counting TIMES, and degrees on the oven.
vocab-n5-dochira: どちら: the ど- family asks "which?" — polite WHICH ONE / WHERE.
vocab-n5-doko: どこ: "doc, oh?" — doc, WHERE did you go?
vocab-n5-donata: どなた: polite だれ — "Donna, tar?" WHO is that, Donna?
vocab-n5-donna: どんな: "Donna" — WHAT KIND of person is Donna?
vocab-n5-dono: どの: "Don, no!" — WHICH one did you pick, Don?
vocab-n5-dore: どれ: "door" — WHICH ONE of these doors?
vocab-n5-dotchi: どっち: casual どちら — "dotch" — WHICH WAY?
vocab-n5-dou: どう: "doe?" — HOW is the deer doing?
vocab-n5-doubutsu: 動物: 動 (move) + 物 (thing) = moving thing: ANIMAL.
vocab-n5-doushite: どうして: "dough, she tay" — WHY did she take the dough?
vocab-n5-e: 絵: "eh?" — what's that PICTURE supposed to be?
vocab-n5-ee: ええ: "eh" with a nod — YES.
vocab-n5-eigakan: 映画館: えいが (movie) + 館 (hall) = CINEMA.
vocab-n5-eigo: 英語: 英 (England) + 語 (language) = ENGLISH.
vocab-n5-en: ～円: 円 also means circle — round coins: YEN.
vocab-n5-erebeetaa: エレベーター: ELEVATOR, Japanese style.
vocab-n5-fuku: 吹く: a mouth 口 blowing out: wind BLOWS. "Foo!" goes the wind.
vocab-n5-fun: ～分: 分 = a knife cutting into parts — time cut into MINUTES.
vocab-n5-furu: 降る: "fool" — only a fool goes out when rain FALLS.
vocab-n5-futari: 二人: "foot tally" — count the feet: TWO PEOPLE.
vocab-n5-futatsu: 二つ: "foot tots" — two little tots: TWO THINGS.
vocab-n5-futoi: 太い: 太 = big 大 with an extra dot — THICK, FAT.
vocab-n5-futsuka: 二日: "foot's car" — two days' drive: SECOND day of the month.
vocab-n5-fuutou: 封筒: "food toe" — I mailed my toe in an ENVELOPE?!
vocab-n5-fuyu: 冬: "phew, you" — phew, you made it through WINTER.
vocab-n5-fyirumu: フィルム: FILM for an old camera.
vocab-n5-gaikoku: 外国: 外 (outside) + 国 (country) = FOREIGN COUNTRY.
vocab-n5-gakusei: 学生: 学 (study) + 生 (life) — a life of study: STUDENT.
vocab-n5-garu: ～がる: "growl" — show that you FEEL something (寒がる, ほしがる).
vocab-n5-gatsu: ～月: 月 (moon) — one moon per MONTH. 一月 = January.
vocab-n5-genkan: 玄関: "gen-can" — leave your shoes at the ENTRANCE.
vocab-n5-go: 五: "go" — FIVE fingers ready to go.
vocab-n5-go-2: ～語: 語 = speech 言 + I 吾 — the LANGUAGE I speak. 日本語 = Japanese.
vocab-n5-gohan: 御飯: "go, han!" — go eat your RICE, Han.
vocab-n5-gyuuniku: 牛肉: ぎゅう (cow) + にく (meat) = BEEF.
vocab-n5-hachi: 八: "hatch" — EIGHT eggs about to hatch.
vocab-n5-hagaki: 葉書: 葉 (leaf) + 書 (write) — writing on a leaf: POSTCARD.
vocab-n5-haizara: 灰皿: 灰 (ash) + 皿 (plate) = ASHTRAY.
vocab-n5-hajimaru: 始まる: "hedge, I'm a rule" — the game BEGINS.
vocab-n5-hajime: 始め: the BEGINNING — はじめまして = nice to meet you (at the start).
vocab-n5-hajimete: 初めて: "Hajime" meets you for the FIRST TIME.
vocab-n5-haku: はく: "hack" your legs into trousers — PUT ON (below the waist).
vocab-n5-hanashi: 話: speech 言 + tongue 舌 — a TALK, a STORY.
vocab-n5-hanbun: 半分: 半 (half) + 分 (part) = HALF.
vocab-n5-hareru: 晴れる: "hare, rule!" — the hare rules on SUNNY days.
vocab-n5-haru: 春: "ha, rue" — ha! no rue in SPRING, only blossoms.
vocab-n5-haru-2: 貼る: "ha, rue" — PASTE a sticker on the window.
vocab-n5-hashi: 橋: "hash-y" wooden planks: a BRIDGE. (箸 is chopsticks!)
vocab-n5-hatachi: 二十歳: "hat-a-chi" — you get your adult hat at TWENTY.
vocab-n5-hatsuka: 二十日: "hat's car" — the TWENTIETH day: hat and car day.
vocab-n5-hayai: 早い: 早 = the sun 日 over a stake 十 — up EARLY at sunrise.
vocab-n5-hen: 辺: "hen" — a hen wandering around the AREA.
vocab-n5-heta: 下手: 下 (low) + 手 (hand) = low-skill hand: UNSKILLFUL.
vocab-n5-heya: 部屋: "hey, yah!" — shout into the empty ROOM.
vocab-n5-hidari: 左: "he dared me" — he dared me to turn LEFT.
vocab-n5-higashi: 東: the sun 日 rising through a tree 木: EAST.
vocab-n5-hiku: 弾く: "he could" PLAY the piano.
vocab-n5-hikui: 低い: "he queue-y" — he's in a LOW, SHORT queue.
vocab-n5-hima: 暇: "he-ma" — he and ma have FREE TIME.
vocab-n5-hiragana: 平仮名: 平 (flat, plain) + 仮名 (kana) — the plain, curvy script: HIRAGANA.
vocab-n5-hiroi: 広い: "hero-y" — a hero's WIDE, spacious hall.
vocab-n5-hito: 人: two legs walking — a PERSON. "He, toe" — he's got toes, he's a person.
vocab-n5-hitori: 一人: ひとり — one person, ALONE. "He, tory" voting alone.
vocab-n5-hitotsu: 一つ: "he, tots" — he has ONE tot.
vocab-n5-hon: ～本: 本 = tree with a line at the root — counter for LONG THIN things like pens.
vocab-n5-hondana: 本棚: 本 (book) + 棚 (shelf) = BOOKSHELF.
vocab-n5-hontou: 本当: "hon, toe" — hon, is it TRUE you broke your toe?
vocab-n5-hoshii: 欲しい: "ho, she" — oh, she WANTS it.
vocab-n5-hosoi: 細い: "hose-y" — a THIN garden hose.
vocab-n5-hyaku: 百: one 一 + white 白 — a HUNDRED. "Hya!" a hundred kicks.
vocab-n5-ichi: 一: one line — ONE. "Itchy" — one itch.
vocab-n5-ichiban: 一番: number 番 one 一 — the BEST, NUMBER ONE.
vocab-n5-ichinichi: 一日: one 一 day 日 — ONE DAY (all day long).
vocab-n5-ii-yoi: いい: "eee!" — squeal of joy: GOOD.
vocab-n5-ikaga: いかが: polite どう — "Ika ga?" HOW about some squid?
vocab-n5-ike: 池: water 氵 + a winding shape: a POND. "Ick, eh" — mucky pond.
vocab-n5-ikutsu: いくつ: "eek, toots" — HOW MANY toots? HOW OLD are you?
vocab-n5-imi: 意味: "me, me" — what's the MEANING of me?
vocab-n5-ireru: 入れる: 入 (enter) — make it enter: PUT IN.
vocab-n5-iroiro: 色々: 色 (colour) twice — all colours: VARIOUS.
vocab-n5-iru: 居る: いる is for living things being somewhere — the cat IS here.
vocab-n5-issho: 一緒: "issue-show" — let's go to the show TOGETHER.
vocab-n5-itsuka: 五日: "it's car" day — the FIFTH day of the month.
vocab-n5-itsumo: いつも: "it's more" — it's more of the same, ALWAYS.
vocab-n5-itsutsu: 五つ: "it's toots" — FIVE little toots.
vocab-n5-ja-jaa: じゃあ: "jar" — WELL THEN, close the jar and go.
vocab-n5-jibiki: 字引: 字 (letter) + 引 (pull) — pulling up words: DICTIONARY.
vocab-n5-jibun: 自分: 自 (self) + 分 (part) = MYSELF.
vocab-n5-jidousha: 自動車: 自 (self) + 動 (move) + 車 (vehicle) = self-moving car: AUTOMOBILE.
vocab-n5-jikan: ～時間: 時 (time) + 間 (interval) = a span of HOURS.
vocab-n5-jin: ～人: 日本人 — a person from a country: "gin" for each nationality.
vocab-n5-joubu: 丈夫: "Joe, boo!" — Joe is STRONG, nothing scares him.
vocab-n5-jouzu: 上手: 上 (upper) + 手 (hand) = upper hand: SKILLFUL.
vocab-n5-juu: 十: a cross — TEN. "Jew-" ten commandments.
vocab-n5-juu-2: ～中: 一日中 — THROUGHOUT the whole day.
vocab-n5-kaban: かばん: "cab, ban" — no BAGS allowed in the cab.
vocab-n5-kabin: 花瓶: 花 (flower) + 瓶 (bottle) = VASE.
vocab-n5-kaburu: かぶる: "cab rule" — cab drivers must WEAR a hat.
vocab-n5-kado: 角: "car door" — the car door hit the CORNER.
vocab-n5-kaesu: 返す: "case-u" — RETURN the case to its owner.
vocab-n5-kagetsu: ～か月: か + 月 (moon) — counting MONTHS: 三か月.
vocab-n5-kai: ～回: 回 = a box inside a box, going round — counting TIMES: 二回.
vocab-n5-kai-2: ～階: 階 = steps — counting FLOORS: 三階.
vocab-n5-kaidan: 階段: 階 (floor) + 段 (step) = STAIRS.
vocab-n5-kakaru: かかる: "car car-rule" — it TAKES two hours by car.
vocab-n5-kakeru: 掛ける: "cake rule" — HANG your coat, PUT ON your glasses.
vocab-n5-kakeru-2: かける: "cake rule" — CALL them about the cake, SIT DOWN to eat it.
vocab-n5-kami: 紙: "come-y" — come write on this PAPER.
vocab-n5-kanji: 漢字: 漢 (China) + 字 (character) = KANJI.
vocab-n5-karada: 体: person 亻 + root 本 — the person's foundation: BODY.
vocab-n5-kariru: 借りる: "Carry, rule!" — carry it home: BORROW. (貸す is lend.)
vocab-n5-kasu: 貸す: "cuss" — they cuss when you don't give back what they LEND.
vocab-n5-kata: 方: polite word for person (あの方) and "way of doing" (書き方).
vocab-n5-katakana: 片仮名: 片 (one-sided) + 仮名 (kana) — angular script for loanwords: KATAKANA.
vocab-n5-katei: 家庭: 家 (house) + 庭 (garden) = HOME, FAMILY.
vocab-n5-kawa: 川: three lines flowing — a RIVER. "Car-wa" — the car fell in the river.
vocab-n5-kawaii: 可愛い: "car why?" — why is that tiny car so CUTE?
vocab-n5-kaze: 風邪: "cuz, eh" — 'cuz of the wind (風) I caught a COLD.
vocab-n5-keikan: 警官: "Kay can" stop you — she's a POLICE OFFICER.
vocab-n5-kekkon-suru: 結婚: 結 (tie) + 婚 (marriage) — tie the knot: MARRIAGE.
vocab-n5-kekkou: 結構: "kek, ko" — that's FINE, ENOUGH, no thanks.
vocab-n5-kesa: 今朝: 今 (now) + 朝 (morning) = THIS MORNING.
vocab-n5-kesu: 消す: "kiss" the candle out — TURN OFF, ERASE.
vocab-n5-ki: 木: a trunk, branches and roots — a TREE. "Key" carved in the tree.
vocab-n5-kieru: 消える: "key, eh, rule" — my keys VANISHED.
vocab-n5-kirei: 綺麗: "key ray" — a ray of light on a CLEAN, PRETTY key.
vocab-n5-kiro-kiroguramu: キロ: KILO, as in kilogram.
